newsitem.title: UK: FTSE ends lower after surprise interest rate rise.
newsitem.headline: FTSE ends lower after surprise interest rate rise.

text.p: Leading UK shares finished sharply lower on Wednesday after an interest rate rise wrong-footed the market, which had predicted no change in rates ahead of a general election.
The FTSE 100 closed down 29.6 points at 3,963.9, falling through key chart support levels on the way.
"A close below 3,980 signals a break of short-term support and a fall back to the 3,900 level," said Chris Chaitow, technical analyst at Robert Fleming Securities.
An uncertain start on Wall Street after the latest batch of economic numbers added to the jitters, traders said.
